claim: 最小定义为两层主张（道德命题旨在报告事实并依事实而真假；至少部分实际为真）；独立于心灵/客观性是附加承诺，不属于最起码的界定。
locator: SEP《Moral Realism》导言："moral claims do purport to report facts and are true if they get the facts right"；"at least some moral claims actually are true"；附加承诺原文 "involving additional commitments, say to the independence of the moral facts from human thought and practice, or to those facts being objective in some specified way"
note: 2026-10-05 复核原句。Rosen 1994 最小/强实在论区分由 S2 §1 补充（"minimal moral realism—which is the denial of noncognitivism and error theory—and robust moral realism—which in addition asserts the objectivity"）。
